claim.text: Microsoft documents that WORKDAY truncates a non-integer days argument and that positive and negative day counts move forward and backward. The base NETWORKDAYS page does not define reversed-range sign, fractional holiday serials, or blank/text/error cells in the holiday range; Formula Atlas should keep those as explicit unverified profile choices until an Excel spot-check.
claim.subject_definition: WORKDAY and NETWORKDAYS in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop

source.excerpt: Microsoft's WORKDAY remarks say a non-integer days value is truncated, and its argument description says positive values yield a future date and negative values a past date. NETWORKDAYS is described as returning the number of whole working days between dates, with an optional holidays list, but the page does not specify reversed-range sign or detailed cell coercion within that list.
source.subject_definition: WORKDAY and NETWORKDAYS in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop
source.scope: Official Microsoft Support function pages retrieved 2026-09-24: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/workday-function and https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/networkdays-function
